name: Kessel Run Ultra
description: Trail ultramarathon event located in North Fruita Desert, Colorado featuring world-class single track trails with sweeping views of the San Juan Mountains and Colorado National Monument. All distances begin on fast, flowing singletrack and progress to steep terrain on the Zippity-Do-Da Trail. Course elevations range from 5,030' to 5,541'. Event includes aid stations, finisher's medal, custom race shirt, bib, and BOCO Technical Trucker hat.
